meta.triageRationale: Small bugfix: one adapter module, one additive optional seam, one test.

body.focus: End the Claude CLI's stdin after the correlated result so the chat lock is released: add an optional endInput() seam to SpawnedProcess (vscode-plugin/src/chat/cli-adapter.ts), implement it in nodeSpawner by ending child.stdin, call it in run() when a correlated Claude turn reaches its terminal event, and add a fake-spawner unit test.
body.summary: Added an optional endInput() to SpawnedProcess, implemented in nodeSpawner by ending the child's stdin, and called it when a correlated Claude turn reaches its own terminal result, so the CLI exits and the chat lock is released. Two fake-spawner tests added; one existing run-config argv test in cli-adapter.test.ts already failed before this change (it expects the old prompt-on-argv form) and is left alone.
